comment: Spec blocks dev Search (/api/search/resolve) answered for the parts of a plan for "Show G7 aid to Africa as a share of G7 aid to all developing countries each year from 1970 to 2024, including imputed multilateral aid." Each parsed search posts that sentence as `user_message`, as the orchestrator's searches do. `africa_bilateral` (spec_6192e5d5..., provider:bilateral by default, provider:inclusive partial) and `africa_imputed` (spec_26d008bb..., no scope choices) are the numerator's two pins; `g7_bilateral` (spec_4ee950c8...) and `g7_imputed` (spec_f0029c47..., every recipient) the DAC2a denominator the orchestrator offered; `dac1` (spec_83b533b6...) the DAC1 total the plan pinned, searched with the net basis carried from the Africa part, so Search drops the stated provider:inclusive entry with cause contributions_counted. `africa_inclusive` (spec_66f1808d...) is the resubmit compiling `africa_bilateral` on provider:inclusive, whose components are the bilateral series and `africa_imputed`'s, and `g7_inclusive` (spec_813a71d2...) the resubmit compiling `g7_bilateral` on provider:inclusive. Each block keeps the fields admission reads; `resolved.unit_conversion`, `sentence_plan`, `trace`, `headline`, `download`, `skills`, `price_bases` and the `*_options` lists are left out. `proposal` is the `propose_plan` call admitted for that question (its question, answer mode, decisions and requirements; `answered` and `amends_version` are left out, since no ask or plan is on record here). `africa_inclusive_stated` is the Africa part searched as "net ODA including imputed multilateral aid", where Search applies the user's words as a text-origin provider:inclusive entry, and `africa_switched_bilateral` Search's answer to the resubmit a plan-card switch of that part to provider:bilateral posts (`harness.scope_choices.switch_entries`). `bilateral_share_bilateral` and `bilateral_share_inclusive` are the parts "bilateral aid" and "total aid including imputed multilateral aid" of "Show G7 bilateral aid to Africa as a share of G7 total aid to Africa including imputed multilateral aid, 2010 to 2024", each counted as its own words say; `separate_bilateral` and `separate_imputed` the parts "bilateral aid" and "imputed multilateral aid" of "Show G7 bilateral aid and imputed multilateral aid to Africa separately, 2010 to 2024".

proposal.question: Show G7 aid to Africa as a share of G7 aid to all developing countries each year from 1970 to 2024, including imputed multilateral aid.

decisions.description: Source for total G7 aid to all developing countries (denominator)
decisions.rationale: In DAC1, total official development assistance (bilateral net disbursements plus core multilateral contributions) measures the provider total of ODA to all developing countries in a single canonical series, avoiding coverage gaps from imputed multilateral sums.

decisions.description: Method of combining bilateral net ODA and imputed multilateral ODA for Africa
decisions.rationale: Per OECD DAC2a convention, bilateral net ODA and imputed multilateral ODA are summed to measure a donor's total contribution to a recipient region, as detailed in skill oda-dac2a.
